summary: A small heading above each section. It reads like a numbered index in calm mode and like a terminal prompt in nerd mode.
purpose: Labels each section in the site's two voices.
why: The label changes with the mode to match the site's theme.
how: Reads the mode. In nerd mode it shows a path and a command line. Otherwise it shows a number and a calm title.
inputs: A number, a calm title, a path, a command, and a class name.
outputs: A paragraph styled as a label.
risks: The nerd prompt has a person's name written into it, so the name is not read from the site data. Changing the name requires editing this file.
debug: If a label looks wrong in one mode, check the props the section passes in.
